Team —
TL;DR: FinTrust's reserved pool (R-FT-12) is at capacity causing elevated latency/5xx. Customer is impacted and CTO is aware. I recommend we: 
1) Approve immediate temporary burst capacity (up to +30% vCPU/GPU slice) for next 6 hours to stop customer impact.
2) Offer proactive credit for performance degradation (scope TBD).
3) Run a post-mortem and recommend model/runtime configuration changes (short-term: increase local KV cache TTLs; mid-term: model quantization/replica adjustment).

Estimated cost of 6-hour burst: ~$3,200. If approved, ops will enact and CS will send advisory.

Decision needed: APPROVE burst + provisional credit? Please reply with YES / NO / NEEDS MORE INFO.

From: "Lukas Meyer" <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>

Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-11T13:25:00-08:00
Subject: RE: High latency / errors observed this morning for API traffic

Sarah — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the disruption. Quick update and next steps:

What happened (short):
- A scheduled bulk job from FinTrust triggered sustained long-context requests which, combined with a recent KV cache TTL change, produced KV churn and queuing in R-FT-12. That pushed the pool close to saturation and increased the P95 latency and 5xx rate.

Immediate mitigation (already in flight):
- Ops applied a temporary +30% burst to the reserved pool at 12:45 PST (actioned after exec sign-off).
- We rolled back a recent global KV TTL change for requests routed to R-FT-12 to reduce cache invalidation.
- We enabled a short-lived rate-limiter per-API-key for the affected endpoints to prevent head-of-line blocking.

Attachments: customer-impact-log.csv (CSV, 28KB)

Follow-ups we propose (next 72 hours):
- Formal incident call with FinTrust SREs and our Capacity team to align on scheduled jobs and traffic shaping (propose: 2027-02-12 11:00 PST).
- Post-mortem to include tuning suggestions: replica increase, smart pre-warming for long-context jobs, and a targeted quantization profile for their dominant model family.
- Draft advisory to send to FinTrust (attached: draft_mitigation_advisory.docx)

We appreciate your patience. I'll be on the incident bridge and available for the 11:00 PST sync — please accept the invite if that time works.

Regards,
Lukas Meyer
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
